about: Releases this hao accepts without a signature (owner waivers), each by version with the owner's words. A release named here is used when its signature file is missing (a bad signature is still refused); its files are still checked against SHA256SUMS and release.json's sha256 pins, and every command says it is unsigned. v0.0.1-beta.1, the first preview, is the only one.

releases.v0.0.1-beta.1: owner 2026-11-22: "Just release the first one unsigned"
